title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1982-04-05

ai_review.summary: A decent audience tape of a mellow Spectrum show with standout Jack Straw and The Wheel, recording fair but still enjoyable.
ai_review.review: The performance captures a classic early‑80s Dead set – the first set is smooth and mellow while the second bursts into an intense Jack Straw jam and a magical rendition of The Wheel. The Sennheiser audience recording is a bit close to the board with some reverb, hollowness and occasional oversaturation, but overall remains listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality averages around 4/5 (strong jams, good energy) while recording quality averages just above 3/5 (fair with noticeable issues). Weighted combination yields ~3.7 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Too close to the board, a bit out of the sweet spot; slight reverb and hollowness, occasional oversaturation early in set 1. Overall respectable for an audience tape, but not crisp like a soundboard.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Mellow, smooth first set followed by a high‑energy second set with extended jams (Bertha → Playing In The Band → Ship Of Fools → The Wheel) that give the show its highlight.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for sweet, clear tone and strong vocals; his playing shines especially on the jam sections.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted as present in the band, no specific remarks beyond that.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland’s keyboard jams are highlighted, especially early “Brent Jam #1” and interplay with Jerry.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann’s hi‑hat work and Mickey Hart’s drumming are singled out as powering the jam sections.
